name: Malik
source:
Malik is a silversmith from Revia specializing in making delicate, intricate silverware. He also does a lot of business in Voleri, so he's befriended Rio over the years.

[From [url=https://court-of-darkness.fandom.com/wiki/Malik]Fandom Wiki[/url]]
